exam_scheme.note: Admission to the Master of Commerce (M.Com) programme at Delhi School of Economics, University of Delhi, is conducted under the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduates (CUET-PG) administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA). Candidates must appear in the Commerce question paper (Paper Code: COQP08). The examination is a single-shift Computer Based Test (CBT) of 105 minutes duration containing 75 domain-specific multiple choice questions (300 marks). 50% of the total seats are allocated under Category 1 (merit for DU B.Com graduates) and 50% under Category 2 (open to all eligible applicants based on CUET-PG score). Seat allocation is finalized through DU's Common Seat Allocation System (CSAS PG).
